title: A Low-PAPR, Synchronization-Robust Non-Coherent Grassmannian Modulation for Optical Communications
summary: Non-coherent Grassmannian (unitary space-time) signaling detects on the received subspace, which is invariant to a branch-side (polarization or mode-coupling) rotation and to a phase that is constant over the coherence block. It therefore needs no carrier-phase or polarization recovery within the block and is robust to phase noise when the per-block phase drift is small, while a multi-branch (polarization or spatial) front end harvests diversity without channel estimation or pilots.
